name: Clans of Tarkir
description: The powerful clans of Tarkir, each worshipping one aspect of the extinct dragons.

timeline.summary: The clans of Tarkir wage a conflict for supremacy over the plane that spans a thousand years.
timeline.quote: Tarkir is an embattled world of ambitious warlords and powerful clans that wage eternal war for supremacy over their plane in a conflict that spans a thousand years.

timeline.quote: but are constantly fending off the hordes of dragons that are terrorizing their world
